questions.question: Identify the correct sentence with formal register and complex sentence structure: 'It was not until the discovery of penicillin that surgery became significantly safer.'
options: It was not until the discovery of penicillin that surgery became significantly safer.
Until the discovery of penicillin, surgery became significantly safer.
Surgery became significantly safer not until the discovery of penicillin.
The discovery of penicillin until surgery became significantly safer.
questions.answer: It was not until the discovery of penicillin that surgery became significantly safer.

questions.question: Which sentence correctly uses inversion to emphasize the adverbial phrase?
options: Only after the rain stopped did they begin to repair the roof.
Only after the rain stopped they began to repair the roof.
They began to repair the roof only after the rain stopped.
Only after the rain stopped being they began to repair the roof.
questions.answer: Only after the rain stopped did they begin to repair the roof.

questions.question: Select the grammatically correct and most appropriate sentence for a formal context: 'Had the research been conducted properly, the findings would not have been so controversial.'
options: Had the research been conducted properly, the findings would not have been so controversial.
If the research had been conducted properly, the findings would not have been so controversial.
The research had been conducted properly, so the findings would not have been so controversial.
The research was not conducted properly, so the findings were controversial.
questions.answer: Had the research been conducted properly, the findings would not have been so controversial.

questions.question: Which option correctly uses a cleft sentence to highlight the specific detail?
options: It was the lack of funding that caused the project to fail, not the complexity of the task.
The lack of funding caused the project to fail, not the complexity of the task.
The project failed because of the lack of funding, not the complexity of the task.
The project failed due to lack of funding, excluding the complexity of the task.
questions.answer: It was the lack of funding that caused the project to fail, not the complexity of the task.

questions.question: Identify the sentence that correctly employs ellipsis to maintain grammatical coherence: 'The committee members present at the meeting agreed unanimously.'
options: The committee members present at the meeting agreed unanimously.
The committee members present at the meeting, they agreed unanimously.
The committee members present at the meeting, agreed unanimously.
The committee members present at the meeting, so agreed unanimously.
questions.answer: The committee members present at the meeting agreed unanimously.
